selection_method: Multi-stage leakage-free selection (Variance Threshold -> Collinearity Pruning -> Random Forest Gini / Mutual Information Ranking)

selected_features.name: heading_cos
selected_features.description: Cosine of the angular difference between the vehicle's instantaneous travel heading and the directed road arc bearing.
selected_features.role: Top discriminatory directional signal. Strongly penalizes road segments running perpendicular or opposite to the vehicle movement direction.

selected_features.name: relative_dist
selected_features.description: Normalized ratio of the candidate's orthogonal distance relative to the nearest candidate arc for the same GPS point.
selected_features.role: Encodes candidate competitiveness locally, ensuring candidate ranking remains scale-invariant across wide boulevards and narrow alleys.

selected_features.name: dist_rank
selected_features.description: Discrete rank order of the candidate arc sorted ascendingly by orthogonal distance among all candidates for the given GPS point.
selected_features.role: Rank 1 contains the true road arc in >90% of observations; strongly guides tree split decisions.

selected_features.name: dist_to_segment
selected_features.description: Exact continuous Euclidean orthogonal distance from the GPS point to the line segment connecting start node u and end node v.
selected_features.role: Foundational spatial proximity feature reflecting Gaussian GPS sensor noise.

selected_features.name: arc_length
selected_features.description: Physical metric length of the candidate road arc segment.
selected_features.role: Provides prior probability weighting: longer road segments span more sequential GPS observation intervals.

selected_features.name: proj_ratio
selected_features.description: Normalized longitudinal projection ratio indicating where along segment [u, v] the orthogonal projection falls (0.0 = node u, 1.0 = node v).
selected_features.role: Distinguishes observations centered along an arc from those near junction endpoints.

selected_features.name: speed
selected_features.description: Instantaneous vehicular speed computed using causal backward differences.
selected_features.role: Interacts with heading reliability; at higher speeds, heading angles are significantly more reliable.

selected_features.name: min_node_dist
selected_features.description: Minimum Euclidean distance from the GPS point to either the entry node u or exit node v.

selected_features.name: delta_x
selected_features.description: Signed metric projection residual along the local tangent plane East-West axis.
selected_features.role: Encodes directional coordinate bias and lateral lane offset.

selected_features.name: dist_to_midpoint
selected_features.description: Euclidean distance from the GPS point to the geometric midpoint of the candidate road arc.

selected_features.name: delta_y
selected_features.description: Signed metric projection residual along the local tangent plane North-South axis.
selected_features.role: Encodes directional coordinate bias and longitudinal lane offset.

selected_features.name: dist_to_v
selected_features.description: Euclidean distance from the GPS point to the outgoing road junction node v.
selected_features.role: Captures vehicle progression toward road arc exit.

selected_features.name: dist_to_u
selected_features.description: Euclidean distance from the GPS point to the incoming road junction node u.
selected_features.role: Captures vehicle entry progression into road arc.

selected_features.name: node_asymmetry
selected_features.description: Absolute difference between the distance to the entry node and the distance to the exit node.
selected_features.role: Indicates relative longitudinal symmetry along the road arc.

pruned_features.name: dist_sq
pruned_features.pruned_reason: High collinearity with 'dist_to_segment' (|r| = 0.869 >= 0.85); 'dist_to_segment' retained due to higher Mutual Information score.

pruned_features.name: log_dist
pruned_features.pruned_reason: High collinearity with 'dist_to_segment' (|r| = 0.868 >= 0.85); 'dist_to_segment' retained due to higher Mutual Information score.

pruned_features.name: heading_diff_deg
pruned_features.pruned_reason: High collinearity with 'heading_cos' (|r| = 0.993 >= 0.85); 'heading_cos' retained due to higher Mutual Information score.
